title: Larkspur Modpack
description: A modpack for mostly vanilla gameplay with a few QoL tweaks
body:
This is a modpack which aims to bring some small QoL changes to the game, with mostly visual and performance changes.

Built with a well rounded experience in mind, it aims to bring performance increases for the more technically orientated or frame conscious players through mods such as sodium and lithium. Yet at the same time, multiple smaller visual mods have been added, such as iris to support shaders, and a saturation slider to completely customise the look of the game to your preferences, along with the EMF and ETF mods to enhance your resource pack experience, supporting custom models and animated textures. And finally there are a few tool mods included to make gameplay easier, such as litematica to help with building farms, and minihud to act as a mini F3 screen.

Overall this modpack is meant to provide a close to vanilla experience but with a few small changes, which work together to create a more pleasant experience while playing. While suited to a wide range of play styles, this pack was specifically made for the Larkspur server, so if you have any questions feel free to ask them in [this discord](https://discord.gg/3yATJvVHW2).

(As this is designed for a specific server originally, the villager pickup mod was included. For fully vanilla mechanics remove this mod)
